device.description: 16-bit 600 kSPS pseudo-differential SAR ADC with SPI-compatible serial interface
device.note: ads8370.pdf (SLAS450) p.3-4 specifications (+VBD 2.7-5.25 V, logic levels, data format via SB/2C), p.5 timing requirements (tconv 1160 ns max), p.6 timing characteristics, p.7 pin assignments and terminal functions, p.17-18 conversion and sampling control (CONVST_QUAL), p.18-19 data read operation (Figure 45, FS = 1), p.23 reading data, Table 1 output codes, p.24-25 power saving

pages: p.3-4 (specs), p.5 (timing requirements), p.6 (timing characteristics: td12 15 ns, td13 10 ns, td14 6 ns), p.7 (pinout, terminal functions), p.17-18 (Figures 38-39, conversion/sample commands), p.18-19 (data read, Figure 45), p.23 (Table 1), p.24-25 (power saving)
notModeled: analog input (0 V to VREF pseudo-differential) and the internal 4.096 V reference (REFOUT never driven); the 0 V code is 0000h with SB/2C low and 8000h with SB/2C high (Table 1)
conversion start is CONVST_QUAL: CONVST latched by CS low (Figure 39), so a CONVST falling edge starts a conversion only while CS is low; the model starts one at every CONVST falling edge
sampling start/wait/nap states (Figure 38), the conversion abort command (Figure 44) and acquisition timing are not modeled
frame-sync read mode (FS active, Figures 46-47: MSB at FS rise or at BUSY fall) is not modeled; tie FS high (SPI mode, Figure 45); a CS fall during a frame restarts the frame
read latency: data read during a conversion is the previous result on the part (the model's result is the constant 0 V code)
PD high resets and powers the device down; the 25-ms internal-reference resume and the first conversions after resume are not modeled; nap mode
quiet-zone timing (tquiet1-3); SCLK is gated by CS internally; tValid/tOut/tFloat at +VBD 2.7-5.25 V
variants: ADS8370I and ADS8370IB (linearity grades of the same chip); the ADS8380 (18-bit) has a separate datasheet with the same pinout and interface
